round_plan.prompt_strategy: camera-response polish only after all semantic and material dimensions pass; no redesign

Refine only local microcontrast, highlight roll-off, focus hierarchy, material-specific highlight balance, white-background tone and final camera response.
Do not use global sharpening, HDR clarity or extreme shallow depth of field.
note: Run only after P9 persistence, body presence and photographic fabric rounds pass.
